description: Netherlands Insolvency Check (Centraal Insolventieregister). Check Dutch companies for insolvency in the official Centraal Insolventieregister (CIR) by KvK number (8 digits; up to 500) or company name (contains-match, at least 3 characters; up to 50), or list every company insolvency published in a recent window (publishedFrom/publishedTo: YYYY-MM-DD, "today", "yesterday" or "-N days", within the last 7 days). One row per company insolvency case with its whole history: caseType bankruptcy (faillissement) or suspension_of_payments (surseance van betaling); status bankruptcy_opened, restructuring_opened, plan_confirmed (akkoord), proceeding_closed, proceeding_revoked or other; isOngoing; openedDate; court and location; case number; KvK, name, trade names, registered address; every publication with date and Dutch text. No row for an entry means the register holds no company insolvency for it - the register keeps cases while they run and for six months after they end, so older ended cases are not returned. An entry the register did not answer is NOT checked (unknown, not clear) and not charged; invalid KvK numbers and numbers with natural-person insolvencies only are skipped and not charged. Companies and other legal persons only - sole traders, VOF partners, private individuals and debt restructuring (WSNP) are never returned; judges and trustees are not named. No API key. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

companyNames.description: Company names to look up, e.g. "Pixelfarming Robotics". The register matches names that contain the text, so a short or common word returns many companies. At least 3 characters. Up to 50 per run.
companyNames.title: Company names

exactNameMatch.description: Off (default): every company whose name or trade name contains the text. On: only companies whose name or trade name equals the query, ignoring case, accents, punctuation and the legal form (B.V., N.V. ...). No effect on KvK numbers.
exactNameMatch.title: Exact name match

kvkNumbers.description: Dutch Chamber of Commerce (KvK) numbers to check, 8 digits, e.g. 70627290. The most precise check - use it whenever you have the number. Up to 500 per run.
kvkNumbers.title: KvK numbers

maxCasesPerName.description: The most insolvency cases returned for one company name, newest first (default 20). KvK numbers always return every case.
maxCasesPerName.title: Max cases per company name

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

publishedFrom.description: Optional. List every company insolvency published in the register from this date, instead of or in addition to the checks above. YYYY-MM-DD, or "yesterday", "today" or "-3 days" (useful in a schedule). Must be within the last 7 days. Billed per company case returned.
publishedFrom.title: New publications from

publishedTo.description: End of the publication window: YYYY-MM-DD, "today" or "yesterday". Leave empty for the same day as "New publications from".
publishedTo.title: New publications to

name: regdata_netherlands_insolvency
